questions.prompt: Why did Cheeky plan a funny surprise?
choices: He wanted the Pals to laugh.
He wanted to spoil the path.
He wanted to hide from Fancy.
questions.answer: He wanted the Pals to laugh.
questions.evidenceText: Cheeky wanted to make the Dino Pals laugh.

questions.prompt: What did Cheeky say after he understood the hurt?
questions.evidenceText: "My jokes hurt your feelings," he said. "I am sorry."

questions.prompt: What makes a joke kind in this story?
questions.evidenceText: Then the friends planned a joke everyone could enjoy.
